notes.title: 🔧FALL GUYS ‘TOOL UP’ UPDATE 🔧
notes.content:
We’ve squeezed a lot of goodies into the latest Update…

The ‘Tool Up’ Update is a builder Bean’s dream, letting you design bigger, busier, and better Rounds in Fall Guys Creative. Excited? Well compose yourself, we’ve also added a music selector and tunes to our level design tools as well as a new Winter themed Skybox! Oh, you’re hungry for more? Delicious treats await everyone in the Fabulous Feast Fame Pass. The food-filled pass is a gorge-ous spread of Costumes for everyone’s taste.

Read on, and welcome to the ‘Tool Up’ Update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/280b8347230d104b3a180d5f75f22e8970d7f11e.png[/img]

[h2]FILL UP THE BLUNDERDOME WITH OBSTACLES, TUNES, AND FOOD-THEMED FROLICS[/h2]

The ‘Tool Up’ Update doubles the Fall Guys Creative building budget from 1,000 to 2,000! That means builder Beans can craft far more elaborate Rounds with extra obstacles, additional decorations, and more. If you’ve ever had an idea for a devious design that was just too big for the Blunderdome, well, there’s now way more room for activities!

[h3]New Soundtracks in Creative[/h3]

To help you get a tune out of Fall Guys Creative… We've added some music. Players now have a selection of official tracks that they can add to their Creative Rounds!

[h3]Object Overlapping[/h3]

You will now have the option to overlap any obstacle in Creative allowing you to flex your creativity even more whilst building your next masterpiece to share with the Blunderdome!

[h3]Unvaulted Rounds[/h3]

We have re-opened the vault and brought back some select Rounds to the Main Show:
[list]
[*] Slime Scraper (Solos, Duos, Squads)
[*] Big Shots (Solos, Duos, Squads)
[*] Pegwin Persuit (Duos, Squads)
[*] Short Circuit (Solos)
[*] Fruit Chute (Solos, Squads)
[*] Volleyfall (Solos, Duos, Squads)
[*] Volleyfall Final (Duos, Squads)
[/list]

[h3]New Shuffle Show[/h3]

Recently we ran Digi’s Shuffle Show which was a solo experience through a number of Creative made Rounds. We have listened to your feedback and prepared a new Shuffle Show except this time you will be playing with others! Jump into the show from today and play through Creative made Rounds with up to 10 other players - good luck!

[previewyoutube=FYhLuBnaxYw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]THE FABULOUS FEAST FAME PASS[/h2]

Dress up for some culinary adventures with the Fabulous Feast Fame Pass, a food-themed buffet of Costumes to unlock to suit every palate. The tantalising takeaway is available from 10AM GMT 7th November to 10AM GMT 12th December.

The Hot and Fresh Costume is an a-dough-able pizza slice to wear. Toppings include pepperoni and hugs. Cooler heads might like the Melon Slush Costume. It's a colourful cup with swirls and straw, and looks so tasty!

The Sweet or Salty Costume has both flavours of popcorn, in bucket pants or atop your head, so no need to choose!

Guac a load of the Avo-Guy-Do Costume, a ripe outfit that’s a half avocado sliced to the pit. It’s the perfect accompaniment to the Chipper Costume, a full bag of crisps that look good enough to dip.

You won’t spill anything in the Baked Beans Costume, despite being a full can with an open lid. We’re also far too amused with the bean-inspired Toot Emote. Yes, it’s a parp.

Our free Wearables are snack-sized unlocks for everyone. Look pan-tastic in the Stainless Helmet, go head over meals for the Chef Hat, or look a-peel-ing in the Banana Boots.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/b2f8a45b4ca8230d623a964830d5b5e8a45a64b0.jpg[/img]

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]

[list]
[*] Switch: Fixed issue where Fall Guys would crash in Creative while docked
[*] Fixed a bug causing blast balls to explode faster than expected. The same was happening with tiles falling.
[*] The 'Cross-Platform Matchmaking' option wasn't saving correctly but has now been fixed.
[*] Fixed visual issues with the Spicy Ramen celebration which led to its smoke VFX always being visible.
[*] We've fixed an issue where the bounce board would sometimes not detect a force on one side.
[*] We've fixed an issue where achievements would incorrectly be unlocked by playing a show or Creative level in a private lobby. This would then make it impossible to unlock the affected achievements.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game becomes unresponsive when the player selects a Creative round in Creative tab and switching to the favourites tab, or selecting a Creative round in My Rounds tab, and switching to most popular.
[*] Camera: We've fixed an issue with camera controls being incorrect while using inverted controls
[*] Fixed spelling mistake for the colour 'Cinnamon Style'
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera would become frozen and show the level's background if other players disconnect during the loading screen.
[*] Creative: Changed Max character count for descriptions from 140 to 170.
[*] Changed 'Season Progress' to 'Pass Progress' on the main menu
[*] Auto-Grab: Fixed an issue where the player incorrectly has auto-grab enabled and isn't able to change this behaviour
[*] Players are now able to leave rounds if all Squad members are eliminated without forfeiting rewards
[*] Fixed an issue with the Starfleet Insignia Banner not having rounded corners on the left side.
[*] Fixed the font on the Theme Selection page so that 'Coming Soon' is consistent with the other options
[*] The Bubble Gum Blowout Celebration now correctly displays its lighting effects and textures in the preview.
[*] [Steam] Steam only friends are now correctly available in the EOS overlay.
[*] Fixed an issue on one of the pop ups in Fall Guys Creative where Polish special characters were not displaying correctly
[*] Fixed an issue with the Pixel Pigeon Costume and its variants having gaps during certain Emotes
[*] The colour 'Primal' now is correctly translated to different languages as expected.
[*] We've updated the Start Line object description to correctly refer to Round Rules instead of 'Rulebook'
[*] We've fixed an issue where draggable objects lose their momentum when being held and released. This was particularly noticeable in mid-air or on slimy surfaces.
[*] Carriable objects placed in the middle part of the Bouncy Board would partially float. We've fixed this and it's no longer the case.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Ice Maiden and Snow Queen upper Costumes having visible gaps around the waist area
[*] Fixed collisions on draggable objects so that players can no longer be clipped into them on conveyor floors
[*] Draggable objects will now react consistently to the wind effect of blizzard fans.
[*] Fixed a lighting issue with the Holey-Half-Pipe object that led to visual artifacts.
[*] Slime floors drain's now correctly change colour with each variation
[*] Original Theme now has the correct ambient occlusion to match the original Season 1 levels.
[*] The hologram shader in the background of Original Theme has been fixed to match the original Season 1 levels
[*] We've fixed an issue that was causing a large FPS drop when pressing Save in the Options Menu
[*] We've fixed an issue in Creative where the air from Draggable Fan Blocks was blocking the creator's ability to select other objects
[*] We've fixed an issue in Creative where changing the 'Item Quantity' of a Carry Object Spawner and then cancelling the change in position would lead to the spawner not spawning the desired quantity of items.
[*] Fixed an issue with Spongebob Costume displaying gaps while performing emotes
[*] Fixed a texture issue with the Carryable Block that was causing its texture to be misaligned.
[*] Fixed an issue where Carryable Fans and Punchers variants could launch the player when grabbing them while in the air.
[*] Fixed an issue where hovering over pressure plates in Creative was causing FPS drops
[*] Fixed an issue where using the Carryable Puncher Forward on the center axis of the Seesaw would cause it to glitch temporarily
[*] The Meteor Strike Celebration had a blurred Fall Guy model in some parts of the animation. This has been fixed.
[*] The wind effect from Push Fans remained after the Push Fan was removed. We've fixed this.
[*] The Punching Gloves had incorrect colours, we've fixed this
[*] The Blizzard Fan would stop affecting Fall Guys if it had a Start Delay and any linkable objects connected. This has been fixed.
[*] The basketball will now trigger buttons when it hits them. There was a bug preventing it from happening.
[*] If the player respawned while the Speed Boost VFX were playing, they wouldn't end for a few seconds. They now end correctly when the player respawns.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Avocado Costume and variants in which the fingers would have a visual gap
[*] Fixed an issue where jumping just before you went through a Speed Arch would cause the boost to be applied twice
[*] Carriable Punchers were not being affected by Conveyors. We've fixed this and they are now moved by Conveyor floors in the same way all other draggable objects are.
[*] There was an issue with missing textures on Carriable Punchers which has now been resolved
[*] The option to 'Skip Level Validation' wasn't being correctly translated to other languages. This is now fixed.
[*] Certain faceplates had their colours incorrectly inverted. This is now fixed.
[*] Bounce Boards can now be snapped with other objects in the Digital Theme
[/list]

We want to thank you, the Fall Guys community, for playing our silly bean game and being the reason we work on these updates. As always, a huge thank you to our brilliant Dev and QA team for sorting these updates and to the entire Fall Guys Team for working so hard to make these changes!

Please remember to always report any in-game issues you face to our wonderful [url=https://www.epicgames.com/help/en-US/fall-guys-c9505712380315]Support Team[/url]. Your feedback and reports are so vital in helping us keep Fall Guys as fun, playable and exciting as possible!

See you in the Blunderdome!

notes.title: FEEL THE SPEED WITH SONIC’S ADVENTURE!
notes.content:
Sonic’s Adventure comes to Fall Guys FAST: on August 11th - 15th!

Running (at blisteringly quick speed) until August 15th, this five day event is one of the best we’ve ever had in the Blunderdome. And it comes with a brand new level, called Bean Hill Zone.

[previewyoutube=5PWtjGTf4bU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]YOU READY TO GO SUPER SONIC?[/h2]

We’ve also got brand new costumes, challenges and Rings - for all you fans of the iconic blue hedgehog. Want to dress your Bean as Knuckles? We got that.

For our main event, players need to score points by picking up rings. It’ll be muscle memory to all you Sonic heads who cut your teeth on the SEGA Genesis.

The aim of each round is to snag as many rings as possible, qualifying for the next round. Those who don’t, get eliminated. There are conveyor belts and log bridges to throw you off your A-game, obviously.

Survive, and you’ll be Top Hog.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/b23e5617351b7a18a11d477dd62cbb10976dbaa3.png[/img]

[h2]GRAB RINGS, GET THINGS[/h2]

No big Fall Guys event feels right without a metric ton of unlockables. We’ve also got Nameplates, Kudos, and Sonic’s own sneakers up for grabs.

They’re reserved for the players who do absolutely everything and sprint to the finish line for those 1000 points.

Check them out!
[list]
[*] [b]Sonic Nameplate - 200 Points
[*] 200 Kudos - 400 Points
[*] Sonic Pattern - 600 Points
[*] 400 Kudos - 800 Points
[*] Sonic Sneakers - 1000 Points[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/03d2e137d8426fafbba6ac33eee5a4b2312f21a3.jpg[/img]

[h2]OUR NEW COSTUMES ARE EXTRA AERODYNAMIC[/h2]

We’ve also got four glorious costumes, all of which look unmistakably like the characters you’ve loved since the early Nineties.

Eggman, Tails, Knuckles, Super Sonic and of course the blue guy himself are all here.

They’re some of our favourite costumes to date! There’s also the ICONIC Sonic Foot Tap emote up for grabs!

It’s about time we put on our running boots and took off. Seeeeeeee ya.

notes.title: MASTER CHIEF ENTERS THE BLUNDERDOME TO CHALLENGE YOU TO A SPARTAN SHOWDOWN!
notes.content:
[h1]Spartan Showdown is now available to play! [/h1]

[previewyoutube=117zjJbGCxk;full][/previewyoutube]

There are events. And then there are EVENTS.

We at Bean HQ are absolutely buzzing to announce that we have a certain Spartan themed - wink wink – event coming to Fall Guys… Yes, that’s right, the hero of video gaming heroes – MASTER CHIEF – will be spartan sprinting his way to the Blunderdome very soon!

Our all new event, Spartan Showdown, comes absolutely packed full of new challenges and Bean-117 themed costumes that’ll raise your wardrobe level to legendary. There’s more fun than you could shake an energy sword at!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/169f924758c580018b72cc9005ebac31cbbf4c89.png[/img]


[h1]STORM THE STORE ROOM[/h1]

We’re going all out with the store items on this collaboration. You like da Brutes? We got a costume for you. You like da Spartan-117? We got a nickname for you. Think Grunts are the best creation in the history of video games? We got a costume and an emote for you. It’s time to hit the ring and indulge in one of video gaming’s most iconic universes.

TL;DR we’re giving you the Keyes to the castle. It’s like a Spartan fan’s dream come true!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/e1220d67033ac2287936ba87c80df0d61cc58eff.png[/img]

[h1]A FLOOD OF UNLOCKABLES[/h1]

We have an onslaught of challenges and goodies to be won and earned throughout the Spartan Showdown event.

We’ve also got the purrfect Helmet accessory that has… er, ears… because reasons.

Here’s just a handful (and luckily you don’t need to save the universe from the Flood to get your Bean mitts on them)
 
[b][olist]
[*] Spartan at Heart (Nickname) - 100 points
[*] 200 Kudos - 200 points
[*] SPARTAN (Nameplate) - 500 points
[*] AI Construct (Pattern) - 700 points
[*] Purrfect Helmet - Upper (Costume) - 1000 points
[/olist][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/689b5860794a223f61d1b444321620b01f26568e.png[/img]


[h1]BIG BLAST BALL ENERGY[/h1]

The Spartan Showdown event is bringing big blast ball energy. You know Blast Balls – you pick them up, throw them at others, they expand until they burst and create untold hilarity.

Every level in the Spartan Showdown has its own 117-nspired variation. And every level will have its own Helmet to collect that counts toward your event challenges! Running for 5 days only, you’ve gotta get some games in soon to unlock these goodies!

See you in the Blunderdome... whatever the cost.

Astro has hopped, jumped and bounced to platforming victory before, but have you ever seen the cute lil’ fella stumble into the Blunderdome Hall of Fame?

[b]Now’s your chance with our latest unlockable costume goodies![/b]

[previewyoutube=GC_PSc0sEDU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]UNLOCK ASTRO AND MORE!  MARCH 8 - 13[/h1]

To earn all the unlocks below, all you have to do is complete the challenges in our brand new game mode, Sweet Thieves!

[list]
[b][*] ‘Astro’ Pattern - 100 Points
[*] ‘Astro’ Nameplate - 200 Points
[*] ‘Astro’ Lower Costume - 400 Points
[*] ‘Astro’ Nickname - 600 Points 
[*] 'Astro’ Upper Costume - 800 Points
[*] ‘Astro’s Wave’ Emote - 1000 Points[/b]
[/list]

[h1]WHAT’S MORE, YOU’LL ALSO HAVE THE CHANCE TO GET YOUR MITTS ON THE CUTE ASTRO BOT T-REX COSTUME![/h1]

This prehistoric prize will become available throughout the Sweet Thieves event, running from March 8 to March 13, and can be purchased from the Fall Guys store.

[list]
[b][*] T-Rex (Upper) - 5 👑
[*] T-Rex (Lower) - 5 👑[/b]
[/list]

[previewyoutube=OxyVufm76Ig;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]SWEET, SWEET VICTORY! PLAY SWEET THIEVES FROM MARCH 8TH![/h1]

On top of all this event goodness, we have a whole new game mode for you to get stuck straight into: Sweet Thieves! This all-new mode has Beans battling it out as two opposing teams. There’s the Guardians and the Thieves.

The objective is simple: the Guardians defend their precious candy, while the Thieves attempt to rob their confectionery treasures from under their sugar-hoarding noses! To win, the Thieves need to get the candy into their goal area, while the Guardians try to catch the thieves and put them in jail.

[b][b]THIEVES[/b]
🍬Steal candy pieces!
🍬Bring them back to your base!
🍬Avoid being seen!

[b]GUARDIANS[/b]
🍬Defend your candy!
🍬Grab thieves to send them to jail![/b]

Thieves are able to push-to-WALK exclusively in this game mode to make it even harder for Guardians to locate and capture them!

Sweet Thieves is live [b]NOW[/b]!! Good luck, and see you in the Blunderdome!

notes.title: Bug fixes? Yes please!
notes.content:
Sometimes things break, sometimes there's some bugs to swat, sometimes beans ascend far into the sky. We're happy to let you all know about the following bug fixes that are now live in Fall Guys!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/f234f382383abca034358f444b9e1c941ed1356e.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b][Gameplay] [/b]Players will no longer float upwards into the sky at the start of a round
[*] [b][Gameplay] [/b]Players will no longer stutter on moving conveyor belts
[*] [b][Gameplay][/b] Conveyor belts will no longer launch players forward continuously after a round ends on levels such as Lost Temple
[*] [b][Gameplay][/b] Players will be correctly eliminated after falling into the slime on levels such as Jump Showdown and Hex-a-gone

notes.title: Fall Guys Season 6 Mid-Season Update: Crossplay Has Arrived!
notes.content:
[b]WELCOME, BEAN FANS![/b] The time has come. Our Season 6 update comes with some of our most-anticipated functionality: you can now party-up with your Fall Guys buddies regardless of whether they’re on PC or PlayStation™, courtesy of some swanky tech from our friends at Epic Online Services! We’re also delighted to introduce a brand-new game mode called Sweet Thieves, as well as a whole host of bug-fixes for you to sink your wrenches into. Let’s gooooooo! 

You can launch into our update right now on [url=https://www.playstation.com/en-gb/games/fall-guys-ultimate-knockout/]PlayStation™[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1097150/Fall_Guys_Ultimate_Knockout/]Steam[/url], but if not, let us take you on a tour of what the new update brings! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/812bb9f68abb04eeeef6865da553801ccff3921f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Crossplay![/h1]

So first and foremost, we’re SO pumped to announce the arrival of cross-platform lobbies! This means that you and your friends can form parties while playing Fall Guys regardless of whether they are on PC or PlayStation™. Though you were previously able to form cross-platform lobbies in Custom Shows, this now means you can party-up and enjoy any of our applicable playlists in Fall Guys—from Squads, to Duos, to Main Show and beyond. 

As long as you and your friends have already linked your Epic Accounts to Fall Guys, you’ll be able to play together by using the “Invite Players” functionality. Don’t worry if you, or others, haven’t linked accounts yet; there’ll be a prompt to do so upon launching the game. Here’s [url=https://www.fallguys.com/en-US/news/fall-guys-cross-platform-progression-epic-games-accounts]more info on linking your Epic account[/url]! Anyone that you already have added as friends on PlayStation™ or Steam will automatically appear in your Epic friends list. To add new friends, simply search for them by using their Epic or PlayStation™ name, and voila - if they also have a linked account their name will appear. 

To invite players to your party in Fall Guys, you can just press “Invite Players” from your main screen, and your Epic Friends will be available to party-up with. Find out more about how this works and check out our FAQs over on our [url=https://support.fallguys.com/]Fall Guys Support Page[/url]. The Support Team is also on hand to help in case you run into any issues!

We know that news regarding [url=https://www.fallguys.com/en-US/news/fall-guys-season-6-party-spectacular-is-out-now]Fall Guys on Nintendo Switch™ and Xbox[/url] is highly anticipated. We're finalising development, and though it isn't within this update, it’s still coming! Until then, we're super excited to enable this cross-platform functionality for our existing platforms as a first step. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/b7d0b0d595df6cc7a962a3e49a33e60fb2b0402d.png[/img]

[h1]Sweet Thieves![/h1]

You may have heard whispers of this mode in the past under a different name - or, perhaps, seen an erroneous image called [b]INVISIBEANS PLACEHOLDER[/b] circa Season 6 launch. Under a new, sweeter name, Sweet Thieves is coming to the game in the very near future. This Round is split into two types of players: Thieves, and Guardians. Whilst the Thieves navigate the level to secure and steal candy pieces, Guardians must locate and detain them, and ultimately send the Thieves to Jail. Don’t worry though, Thieves can free each other at the push of a button… 

Oh, and did we mention it comes with a new mechanic?! Exclusive to this mode, you’ll be able to make your Fall Guy walk, instead of run. Perfect for all of you sneaky beanies. 

But we don’t want to jump the (chewing) gum - you’ll see a deep-dive and trailer on this mode very soon. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/e40eaefdba85fe4e1133f930db67902f40803369.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Fixes and Improvements! [/b][/h1]

We’ve had our swatters out, put up our flypaper, and squashed a whole host of bugs in this update. Piping hot, straight from our QA team, here’s the list of fixes and improvements that accompanied this update:

[list]
[*] [b][Customs][/b] Fixed some instances where a lobby would fail to load on second playthrough, forcing players to make new lobbies
[*] [b][Jump Showdown] [/b]Fixed players being able to stand on the central pillar and evade the spinning bars 
[*] [b][Squads] [/b]Fixed an issue on race Rounds where the Round would end early after a timer is displayed 
[*] [b][Squads] [/b]Fixed Jump Showdown time-outs on Squads eliminating victorious players
[*] [b][Eliminations] [/b]Fixed some instances where players would be wrongfully eliminated on elimination levels, such as being eliminated Jump Showdown in spite of not colliding with the bar
[*] [b][Fall Mountain] [/b]Big Yeetus buff 
[*] [b][Short Circuit][/b] Fixed some instances where players would not qualify upon crossing the second lap 
[*] [b][Sum Fruit] [/b]Fixed players getting stuck between the ramp and the tiles 
[*] [b][Stompin Ground][/b] Fixed the Rhinos charging at players unexpectedly with no visual indication beforehand 
[*] [b][Jump Showdown] [/b]Improvements to other players visually teleporting when jumping over the bar 
[*] [b][Emote][/b] Adjusted the Piano emote so that it does not cut off abruptly in-game
[*] [b][Fall Mountain] [/b]Fixed players ragdolling when interacting with a stationary turnstile 
[*] [b][Lost Temple] [/b]Players will no longer be slowed down or halted by walking over the bottom ledges of open doors 
[*] [b][Full Tilt][/b] Fixed some See-Saws tilting more than others on the level 
[*] [b][Roll On][/b] Fixed some players falling through the platform floors into the slime 
[*] [b][FPS][/b] General improvements to FPS which should decrease instances of framerate drops 
[*] [b][Obstacles] [/b]Fixed rotating bar not matching direction of arrows on levels such as Big Fans 
[*] [b][Slimescraper][/b] Fixed bases of Punchers appearing low-quality 
[*] [b][Crown][/b] Winners will now be correctly awarded in the event of a tie during the Crown Grab on levels such as Fall Mountain and Lost Temple 
[*] [b][Costumes][/b] Fixed visual issues on costumes including but not limited to Deep Diver, Fish Tank, Barbarian, Burly Barbarian, Jester, Fool, Lady Margot, Aloy, Snow Queen, Ice Maiden, and team colour issues on costumes such as Ghost, Jin, and Aloy
[*] [b][Achievements][/b] Fixed issues with unlocking Stumble Chums and Big Bully 
[*] [b][Gameplay][/b] Improvements to carrying objects - when a grab is broken, characters will not ‘ping’ out of place 
[*] [b][Gameplay] [/b]Improvements to ‘bean tornadoes’ in which many close-together players moving at once cause unpredictable collisions 
[/list]

Please remember to always report and in-game issues you face to our wonderful [url=https://support.fallguys.com/hc/en-us]Support Team[/url]. Your feedback and reports are so vital in helping us keep Fall Guys as fun, playable and exciting as possible! 

We hope you have fun playing and that you’re as excited to play our new mode, as we’ve been to release it! For all the latest Fall Guys news, including drop dates for Limited Time Events, costumes and collaborations, visit our official [url=https://twitter.com/FallGuysGame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/fallguysgame/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@fallguysgame]TikTok[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/Fall-Guys-Ultimate-Knockout-113303923394044]Facebook[/url]. Never stumble alone and join the shenanigans on [url=https://discord.com/invite/fallguys]the official Fall Guys Discord[/url].

See you in the Blunderdome!

notes.title: FALL GUYS SEASON 6: PARTY SPECTACULAR IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Calling all V.I.Beans - you’re invited to the Fall Guys Season 6: Party Spectacular! This season brings a whole host of new Rounds, obstacles, and outfits, as well as:

[list]
[*] More Limited Time Events - starting with Sackboy!
[*] 50 tiers of rewards to unlock in the Fame Path
[*] Fame Path exclusive costumes Jin and The Ghost
[*] [url=https://fallguys.com/news/fall-guys-cross-platform-progression-epic-games-accounts]New features via Epic Games Accounts,[/url] including cross-platform progression between PS4 and Steam, and the return of custom usernames
[/list]
As this is the last season of 2021, we wanted to say a special thanks to everyone in the Fall Guys community. It’s been a wild year for us Tonics: joining the Epic Games family, exploring new features (Custom Lobbies, Squads Mode, Limited Time Events) each season to make Fall Guys even more fun, working with some of our favorite IPs (Sonic, TRON, Among Us, Godzilla (?!)) and all while we’re still learning how to develop games working from home.

We are hyped because Season 6 brings us closer to our goal of bringing Fall Guys to as many people as possible, with Epic Game Accounts bringing cross-platform progression and then cross-platform play between PlayStation and PC this season. This will take some testing and learning on our part, as we want to make sure we can deliver the best possible experience to players, no matter which platform they prefer to play on. It's also an important step towards bringing Fall Guys to additional platforms.

We know everyone’s excited about Fall Guy coming to Nintendo Switch™ and Xbox, with good reason. There's been a lot of speculation on social media connecting these new console releases to the Season 6 launch and we want to clarify that that's not the case so no one’s left confused looking for the game on these platforms. Thank you for being patient with us, it's one of our top priorities in active development and we can't wait to share more details with you in 2022.

In the meantime, you can dive into our brand new season right now and join the jubilations of Season 6 - Party Spectacular. Dive in for a closer look at the ultimate carnival of Crowns:

[previewyoutube=nYZJtwNqNS0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]PARTY ON WITH FIVE NEW ROUNDS[/h2]

And the beans go wild! We’ve got five new Rounds hitting the main stage, stacked with a frankly ridiculous assortment of never-before-seen obstacles to test your stumbling skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/85d4f1272588818bebaab2fca4a426760639adb1.jpg[/img]

[b]PARTY PROMENADE[/b]
The party starts here in our wildest gauntlet to date, packed with all-new obstacles! In this celebration of clumsiness, navigate your bean through zooming vacuum tubes, dodge water balloon cannons and swing to victory on the awesomely acrobatic trapeze bars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/0be60134d6a8e543adb793e16a690913e56f906a.png[/img]

[b]FULL TILT[/b]
A fiendishly fresh take on a Fall Guys classic. We’re debuting our dizzyingly new 360° see-saws in a treacherous race to the finish. Beware the force fields and rapid rotating bars, primed to boot you off the festival lineup!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/081767f49bae1f401615673592969616e24d9b10.jpg[/img]

[b]PIPE DREAM[/b]
A totally tubular dash to the finish line. Every trip to the Pipe Dream brings a different maze challenge, with each vacuum tube potentially leading to stumbling peril. You may meet flippers and fans, perilous pivoting platforms or..? No spoilers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/c480242ec320a80ba8af5b06fc465ea126e282c1.png[/img]

[b]AIRTIME[/b]
Your Fall Guys flight to Airtime is now departing! Strive to stay in the air for as long as possible via outrageous displays of aerial agility. Swing on trapezes and practice your fancy footwork on conveyor belts and rotating platforms. And if you fall? Drums and flippers await to put you back in the limelight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/fc3a262b452970630236b1702ed379653fe929b8.jpg[/img]

[b]LEADING LIGHT[/b]
In the greatest game show in the universe, who wouldn’t want to be in the spotlight? But fame isn’t easy when you’re tumbling over turntables and floundering over fans! Beware, as crafty beans won’t want to share the headline slot, using force fields to disrupt your flow and become the centre of attention!

[previewyoutube=Sb-wIE1zi_g;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]CROSS-PLATFORM PROGRESSION COMES TO FALL GUYS WITH EPIC GAMES ACCOUNTS![/h2]

We know some folks like to stumble on multiple platforms. That’s why we’re bringing Epic Games Accounts to Season 6, meaning you can take your progress with you...wherever you choose to play!

Everything from your favourite bean looks, to fancy nameplates, to Fame Path progress can be linked to your Epic Games Account. Do you prefer to stretch out for a bit of PlayStation action with pals...but prefer to stream from Steam? Cool - now, do both but with the same progress!

Plus, PC players can enjoy the return of custom names! Whatever you have for your Epic Games Account will also appear in-game. No more relying on the name generator!

These changes are just the start of our quest to make playing Fall Guys everywhere you choose as seamlessly connected as possible, with Epic Lobbies & Friends Lists support coming later in the season. Woo!  We’ve put together a [url=https://support.fallguys.com/hc/en-us/sections/4409123096338]real detailed FAQ on our Support page[/url] which has all you need to know about cross-platform progression and the future of Fall Guys.

[previewyoutube=IBkEVgSepY4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]NEW COSTUMES, LIMITED TIME EVENTS AND FAME PATH REWARDS[/h2]

Season 6’s Fame Path is overflowing with goodies to get you fully equipped for the Party Spectacular! Your Blunderdome antics will set you tumbling through 50 tiers of rewards with more than 20,000 Kudos to unlock, over 20 Crowns, ludicrously colourful costumes and other treats.

Plus, we’ll have some super special guests joining the festivities. Prepare you beans to train as Jin and become The Ghost with two costumes optimised for stealthy stumbles - unlock them in order, exclusively in the Season 6 Fame Path.

No new season party would be complete without the hottest fall looks, so prepare to jump into over 25 new costumes of carnival couture, guaranteed to send you to the slime in style.

Your Blunderdome Construction Crew have been preparing a platter of new Limited Time Events to reward our most dedicated beans! Plus, we’ve implemented a slew of fixes and improvements for smoother stumbles, based on feedback from our players.

[list]
[*] [b]More Limited Time Events[/b] - More incredible rewards, more challenges, more wild Show variations...MORE! And it all kicks off with the burlap bundle of joy, Sackboy!
[*] [b]Roll Off returns![/b] - Circular tumbles are back in the Final Round, with multiple fixes now in place.
[*] [b]Flipping wonderful[/b] - Issues solved with multiple beans using the same Flipper on Rounds such as Tundra Run and Short Circuit.
[*] [b]Spectate on the Squad[/b] - Spectator Mode fixed to now automatically pan to Party members.
[/list]
 
Dive into the full list of seasonal improvements in our [url=http://www.fallguys.com/news/fall-guys-season-6-patch-release-notes]Release Notes,[/url] straight from the team! And be sure to check out our [url=https://trello.com/b/mJEAmorl/fall-guys-public-issue-tracker]Public Issue Tracker[/url] to see the issues we’re aware of and any bugs that we’re plotting to squish next.

We’re beyond excited to welcome you to the Season 6 Party Spectacular and to hear your thoughts on the latest bean festivities. All the latest Fall Guys news, including drop dates for Limited Time Events and costumes can be grabbed from our official [url=https://twitter.com/FallGuysGame]Twitter,[/url] [url=https://instagram.com/fallguysgame]Instagram[/url] and [url=http://tiktok.com/@fallguysgame]TikTok.[/url] Never stumble alone and join the shenanigans on the official [url=https://discord.com/invite/fallguys]Fall Guys Discord[/url] and sign up for delightful updates direct to your inbox with our [url=https://fallguys.us10.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=692c7ea665858141f269a8c72&id=fcf3504950]Newsletter.[/url]

We’ll see you in the Blunderdome.

notes.title: Season 5.Fun update drops today!
notes.content:
Greetings, bean fans. Your Blunderdome Construction Crew have been hard at work exploring new content, fixes and fiendish variations to delight, challenge and perhaps even win a cheeky smile from our players.

That’s why we’re delighted to share Season 5.Fun with you—our first of multiple bite-sized updates to your jungle-dome experience! You can grab all the details in our [url=https://fallguys.com/news/season-5-fun-release-notes-fall-guys]release notes.[/url] Otherwise, dive in with us and meet the new hype…

[previewyoutube=gh5lluSqQkk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New Round alert! Sum Fruit[/h2]
Put on your thinking caps, a fresh logic Round is heading to the Blunderdome! Sum Fruit is all about quick-thinking beans, calculated movements and high-rising slime.

Oodles of fruit are blasted into the arena for players to count up, as answer tiles appear in the air (think Perfect Match but...extra floaty dangerous). Numbers will materialise on the big screens which match the sum of one group of fruit...but which one?! Pick carefully as that’s the platform to dive for!

Wrong additions will see you slime-subtracted from the round. Bye bean!

[h2]Fresh Round variations galore![/h2]

We’ve gone wild with Round variations, adding dozens of fresh takes to your stumbling experience. This time, we’ve particularly focused on the Rounds you thought you knew best, with multiple Season 1 classics sprinkled with unexpected obstacles and strategy-shifting twists.

These will turn up when you least expect it, so prepare for…

[list]
[*] Fall Mountain - Anti-gravity zones and feisty flippers!
[*] Gate Crash and Door Dash - Path-altering obstacles and conveyor belts join the fray.
[*] Slime Climb - Expanding balloons added to end sequence, careful now!
[*] Bubble Trouble - Watch out for...King Frog! That’s all we’re saying.
[*] Treetop Tumble - Get super floaty with an anti-gravity variant.
[*] Door Dash - A serene ending with added water feature...oh, and expanding balloons.
[*] ...And loads more!
[/list]

We’ve also implemented a swathe of fixes for a smoother stumbling experience! You can read more about these in our release notes - as well as keeping up to date with our [url=https://fallguys.com/issue-tracker]Public Issue Tracker.[/url]

You can dive into Season 5.Fun right now and we’d love to hear what you think! Let us know and keep up to date with all the Fall Guys happenings via our official social media channels, including [url=https://twitter.com/FallGuysGame]Twitter,[/url] [url=https://instagram.com/fallguysgame]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://tiktok.com/@fallguysgame]TikTok.[/url] You can also dive into our official [url=https://discord.com/invite/fallguys]Discord[/url] server and sign-up for bean updates straight to your inbox with our [url=http://eepurl.com/hlEy8T]Newsletter.[/url]

See you in the Blunderdome!

notes.title: Fall Guys: Ultimate Knockout - Season 5 OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Get ready to stumble in the jungle! Fall Guys: Ultimate Knockout Season 5 is live right now, fully-equipped with an adventurous theme featuring giant swinging logs, a mysterious Lost Temple and...mechanical Rhinos?! Our latest major update will have your beans diving and dashing through six new Rounds, with all new ways to Squad up with your pals, plus Limited Time Events brimming with unique rewards and challenges!

[previewyoutube=DfR40c7Tl8M;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


You can start your epic bean expedition right now! Otherwise, get out your treasure map and join us on a journey to the heart of Season 5…

[h2]Six new Rounds![/h2]
The Blunderdome Construction Crew have let their imaginations run wild with six delightfully adventurous Rounds— including an all new Final! Each is packed with fresh mechanics, tactical innovations and some of our most ridiculous obstacles to date...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/8965c8b6efd59e1845906758ddfc1f075a498f34.png[/img]

[b]Treetop Tumble[/b]
New Season, new signature gauntlet! Treetop Tumble will have you tackling your own stumbling storyline, with branching routes to the finish line through multiple layers of chaos. Filled with all new obstacles, including perilous Log Swings and Expanding Frogs (yes, seriously), you’ll need to tumble with caution - after all, who knows where your choices will take you..?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/63e87f195a17eae0e65677768ef14fcfdec17187.png[/img]

[b]Stompin’ Ground[/b]
The beans have stumbled into Rhino territory...and they are not amused! Dash, dive and dodge in a hectic escape from three mechanical Rhinos who love nothing more than sending players to the slime. Drum pads may bounce you to safety, but in Stompin’ Ground, only the agile will qualify.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/7e5121a5669692958af833a59108d7dc334278d3.png[/img]

[b]Lost Temple[/b]
Introducing our most ambitious Round to date...and it’s a new final! Intrepid beans are invited to explore the shape-shifting wonders of the Lost Temple in a frantic dash for the Crown. Attempts to discover the perfect route through its fiendish rooms are futile, as the path to victory is ever-changing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/61b60a6fadcdeeb16eecfaa2de41e2682bf3aa7c.png[/img]

[b]Lily Leapers[/b]
Bounce to the bean rhythm of Lily Leapers, where jump control and aerial precision are the keys to avoiding a watery dip! Conquer each layer by leaping from drum to drum, avoiding low-flying competitors and keeping an eye out for that perfect landing. Blunderdome rumours suggest you can even reach the finish line without touching the floor...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/17a8a500444d437fb254c806d4be32e20f25e78c.png[/img]

[b]Bubble Trouble[/b]
Bubble Trouble is a five-way arena bout that’s all about rapid-fire beans and bubble poppin’ dreams! Zip between the obstacle-filled active zones to rack up the points and collect your way to glorious qualification.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/c8e17f9f197842d4fac92feec68c9e82feadcba5.png[/img]

[b]Pegwin Pool Party[/b]
Crash the Pegwin Pool Party! This solo take on Pegwin Pursuit drops you into a watery wonderland of zippy slides and glistening water pools, with the sole goal of grabbing those pesky Pegwins. The longer you cling on, the more points you’ll gain, so get zooming across those multiple floors and grab for victory!


[previewyoutube=aKzQ4D5xqNY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Countdown to Limited Time Events![/h2]

Season 5 isn’t just about bringing the jungle japes! We’re debuting our Limited Time Events feature, bringing a whole new way to conquer the Blunderdome that’s absolutely packed with limited-time challenges and unique rewards for players of all skill levels.

These extra-special occasions will be dropping throughout Season 5, with each Limited Time Event unlocking a treasure-laden pathway to untold riches (well..rare costumes, emotes, nameplates, patterns and other desirable treats)

As a sneak peek, if you’ve had your eye on the glorious Golden Hotdog costume, you may want to prepare your beans for the upcoming Glizzy Gang Showdown! And who knows, maybe we’ll be inviting some special guests along to help out?


[previewyoutube=RoPVmIMdnQY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Season 5 Squad goals![/h2]
We’re firm believers that Fall Guys is extra fun when there’s friends involved and Season 5 is the perfect time to assemble your adventuring dream team and hop into Squads mode. Share the fun! notes.title: Fall Guys' latest mid-season update out now bringing two new stages and more
notes.content:

As detailed over on the Fall Guys subreddit, Season 4.5, which is out now on PC and PlayStation 4, introduces two brand-new rounds - Slimescraper and Button Bashers - as well as a total of 55 variations across 12 rounds. Slimescraper is described as spiritual successor to Slime Clime, tasking players with outrunning slime and mastering "multiple floors of mayhem", while Button Bashers is a 1v1 round in which players are split into duelling pairs - the winner being the one with the most points when the timer runs out.

As for those new level variations, a full list isn't available, but developer Mediatonic has confirmed low-gravity versions of Hex-a-gone and Thin Ice.

notes.title: Fall Guys - Season 4.5 is out NOW!
notes.content:
Today marks the release of Season 4.5, our major Mid-Season Update that brings heaps of new content to the Blunderdome. Tumble in for some lovingly enhanced futuristic Fall Guys action, including:
[list]
[*] Two new Rounds
[*] Custom Lobbies
[*] Dozens of fiendish Round variations
[*] Plenty of fixes and improvements for smoother stumbling.
[*] ...and more!
[/list]

You can dive in right now or check out the full list in our [url=https://fallguys.com/news/fall-guys-ultimate-knockout-season-4-5-release-notes]Release Notes.[/url] Otherwise, stick with us for all the juicy details. Run the trailer!

[previewyoutube=46EhBeKJHHE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Double trouble: Two new Rounds![/h2]

Your pals in the Blunderdome Construction Crew have delved deep into their imagination to deliver two funky fresh Rounds. Come meet the new hotness…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/33a4a37b21cc9af1c29d307846c1dfef140c33ef.png[/img]

[h3]The Slimescraper[/h3]

Bing! This elevator is officially out of service! To reach the summit, intrepid beans will have to outrun the slime and master multiple floors of mayhem in this spiritual successor to Slime Climb.

The Slimescraper snakes its way through a frankly ridiculous amount of obstacles that are ripe for short-cut strats, featuring Laser Swings, Conveyor Belts and the all-new Rotating Blades (think Big Fans but...extra silly). Plus, plenty more intricately crafted devices to send you spinning to an early slime bath.

Reach the end and prepare for some multi-bean multi-ball, with a top floor of pinball flippers that breach all known safety regulations. Those Bounce Poles may help in a pinch, but touch the slime and you’re outta there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/3546ef0a29636e497d210c85404a0c4e613537ac.png[/img]

[h3]Button Bashers[/h3]

Fall Guys just got personal! Our latest update drops 1v1 tension to the Blunderdome, splitting players into duelling pairs across multiple mini-arenas.

Confronted with 7 buttons, it’s fastest fingers first with beans rampaging to get to the lit platform before their opponent. First contact grabs you a point...but also kicks off an extra spicy effect! Maybe gravity decides to take a break? Perhaps our old friend the Fan fancies an inconvenient visit? It’s on you to ride it out.

Most points at the end of the timer wins, with qualification to the victor. End up in a stalemate and it’s overtime!

[h2]Custom Lobbies for all![/h2]

Season 4 saw the early access roll out of Private Lobbies, enabling select players the chance to host lobbies with beans of their choice. The team has long been exploring how to make this bigger, better and open to more players—so we are absolutely delighted to share a new and improved version for all Blunderdome denizens! It’s time to meet ‘Custom Lobbies’...and everyone’s invited!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/51915ff128b193d29a65ee7ab64f6e67be2e31b3.png[/img]

Custom Lobbies enable any player to host their own invitation-only Fall Guys match-up! Up to 60 players can join via a unique code—and with crossplay supported, your pals can dive in regardless of platform. If you’re streaming, why not get chat involved? Chat’s great at Fall Guys.

And if you’re a little more selective about who you stumble with, that’s cool too. Custom Lobbies with as few as four players can still take on Shows!

We’ll be keeping a keen eye on community feedback to make it the best it possibly can be, so we can’t wait to hear what you think!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/deb0486a4c165505d2a26f00b654ad023a033fb3.png[/img]

[h2]So. Many. Round. Variations.[/h2]

It wouldn’t be a Mid-Season Update without a wild selection of Round variations and rest assured, the team have concocted some ludicrous additions to your favourites.

Appearing when you least expect it, you’ll be spotting some mighty Round remixes, including Thicc Bonkus gatecrashing Short Circuit, Low Gravity Zones causing havoc in Hoverboard Heroes and Boxing Gloves packing an unexpected punch in Ski Fall. There’s absolutely loads more but we’re not going to spoil them here...dive in and find them all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/f015a1396faa0033c1fdbea96463ab21e5df683f.png[/img]

[h2]New features, fixes and improvements[/h2]

Season 4.5 also brings heaps of new quality of life changes, functionality and bug fixes, including…

[list]
[*] Crossplay - Our initial roll out means PS4 and Steam players can now play together in all game modes where lobbies merge (but not crossparty group play...yet!). We’ll be continuously finessing our approach to this over time.
[*] Player Reporting - See a bad bean doing what they shouldn’t be? You can now let us know in-game.
[*] Connection quality indicator - Easily check your connection to help troubleshoot pesky issues.
[*] Latency improvements - Things should now feel much more responsive, particularly mantling and grabbing objects.
[/list]

You can also keep an eye on our ongoing work via the [url=https://trello.com/b/mJEAmorl/fall-guys-public-issue-tracker]Fall Guys Public Issue Tracker.[/url]

As always, none of this would be possible without the passion and openness of our wonderful Fall Guys community, so a huge thank you for your Season 4 feedback so far. Keep it coming!

Fall Guys: Ultimate Knockout Season 4.5 is available to play [b]right now![/b] You can keep to date with all the Fall Guys happenings via our official social media channels, including [url=https://twitter.com/FallGuysGame]Twitter,[/url] [url=https://www.instagram.com/fallguysgame/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@fallguysgame]TikTok.[/url] You can also dive into our official [url=https://discord.com/invite/fallguys]Discord server[/url] and sign-up for bean updates straight to your inbox with our Newsletter.

notes.title: Fall Guys - Season 4 is OUT NOW
notes.content:
Welcome, bean of the future, to [b]Fall Guys: Ultimate Knockout Season 4[/b]! Our stupendous neon-drenched update is available to play [b]right now[/b], so come stumble through time to a Blunderdome full of synthetic beats and fluorescent treats.

[previewyoutube=deFT2P074WU;full][/previewyoutube]

Astronauts, aliens and the funkiest looking Fall Guys this side of synthwave will bumble their way through a sci-fi inspired Season packed with seven new Rounds, oodles of challenges, costumes and delicious features!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/90399d5d71b2e0ea9467fe71c9eb95ca4ce09e24.jpg[/img]

[h2]SQUAD GOALS![/h2]

Season 4 is truly the Season of the Squad, with a slew of new features that elevate playing with pals. Our latest update brings meaningful new mechanics, Round types and currency that are laser-focused on making stumbling with your Squad strategic, rewarding and a whole heap of bean-based fun!

[b]Squads Mode[/b]
Players can now qualify together as a Squad of 4—if any of your Squad win the final Round, you all share in the spoils of victory! If you know the familiar feeling of backing out because that one friend keeps getting yeeted into the slime...we hear you. Season 4 means your Squad sticks together, wins together and most importantly, embarasses themselves in unity.

[b]Squad Race[/b]
The first of two fresh Squad-flavoured Round types for Season 4, Squad Race provides a collective twist to your mad dash to the finish line! Race as a team and the sooner you finish, the more points you earn for your Squad. The lowest scoring Squads get eliminated, so every Squad player’s performance matters. Go go go!

[b]Squad Survival[/b]
Slime just got social! Squad Survival is all about keeping afloat as a team and racking up those precious points. The longer you stay out of the slime, the more points you earn for your Squad, so disrupting other beans is strongly encouraged! Lowest points? Bye!

[h2]A futuristic bounty of new Rounds![/h2]

We’ve unleashed 7 Rounds of futuristic fumbling for Season 4, optimised for the playful needs of all techno-beans...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/0256a0e3e4616a25634c486c98785bfc24fc774f.png[/img]

[b]Skyline Stumble[/b]
Our new 60-player gauntlet showcases a mega assortment of fresh futuristic obstacles, including Low Gravity Zones, Forcefields and Lasers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/fd8406bac85197bdedd4e027fca3a416f668bb92.png[/img]

[b]Hoverboard Heroes [/b]
Set sail for slimy seas as players dive and stumble over perilous obstacles. Ride out the chaos on the cruising hoverboard ‘til the finish line or face elimination!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/858f634ed9b624b9281652ca661821017b486915.png[/img]

[b]Basketfall[/b]
Team up to shoot some hoops in low gravity. This is the Fall Guys future, so prepare for a very silly number of basketballs, outlandish dunks and triple hoops!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/1f9d62fcfe8726fd9c9f14b0a8c2cf0f32e6ec53.png[/img]

[b]Short Circuit[/b]
A new type of racing Round drops beans on the grid and propels them through lap after lap of gravity-defying, obstacle-strewn mayhem!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/79cedf2a3efe3b38bfcc6bdd43ab78171edc287e.jpg[/img]

[b]Power Trip[/b]
Stumble onto the future-funk dancefloor and light up those tiles in a battery-powered battle for disco domination!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/2f52a283b201c847c11b2c92e2779e3720f92404.png[/img]

[b]Big Shots[/b]
Ever wondered what it’d be like to stand on a See Saw while inflatable stars, magnets, gamepads, and miniature Saturns were shot at you? Let’s find out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/8fa2548304626208f1b8f98184733b5c0975976b.png[/img]

[b]Roll On[/b]
It’s Roll Out...but a race!? In this classic-themed Round, 60 players dash to the finish line over a series of rambunctious rotating drums. Don’t fall off! (You will probably fall off).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/c1dfea123dfd1f4be2d07dea52e4cdd93463ef4b.png[/img]

[h2]New rewards assured![/h2]

Season 4 introduces a brand new Challenges feature to reward our most eager beans, plus Crown Shards—the currency of the future!

[b]Daily Challenges[/b]
Play a bunch of Fall Guys? Cool! You’ll now find a hearty selection of custom Challenges every day to test your bean abilities, with the opportunity to earn absolutely bundles of Fame and Crowns Shards! Wait, Crown Shards..?

[b]Crown Shards[/b]
Yes! Victories with your Squad and completing Daily Challenges will now yield you a whole bunch of shiny new Crown Shards. Earn 60 of these and you’ll be the proud owner of a coveted Crown. You’ll be able to check your Crown Shard balance via the Show Selector screen, so keep an eye out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/fb97a72e661432e2293fbd61855f5f11c806253f.png[/img]

[h2]More more more![/h2]

As always, we’ve kept an eager ear out for feedback from the (absolutely amazing) Fall Guys community and Season 4 will bring a whole host of fixes and improvements to ensure the smoothest stumbling possible. It is the future, after all.

[b]Sturdier beans [/b]- We’ve improved our Fall Guys to be more resilient when it comes to taking hits, whether from fellow beans or obstacles. No more ragdolling just because another bean brushed you in mid-air!
[b]Quit anytime after elimination[/b] - No more waiting for the next Round to load. Hit the slime? Leave in double-quick time.
[b]Bug fixes and improvements[/b] - Changes sweep through the Blunderdome, including steps to address latency-related issues, visual tweaks and a fairer Fall Mountain line-up.

If you’d like to dig deeper into these fixes and improvements, tumble into our in-depth [url=https://fallguys.com/news/patch-notes-fall-guys-season-4-update]patch notes[/url], delivered straight from the team. Plus, expect a vast selection of ultramodern fashions and cybertronic costumes, numerous nameplates and all manner of other cosmic cosmetics as Season 4 rolls out.

[h2]Exclusive Costume Packs![/h2]

Finally, we’ve got two new Costume Packs hitting the stores! 

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1569400/Fall_Guys__Popstar_Pack/]Popstar Pack[/url] grants your bean true Blunderdome pop idol status, with three neon funk looks designed to win fans, hearts and Crowns! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1569400/Fall_Guys__Popstar_Pack/

Meanwhile, the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1570380/Fall_Guys__Future_Fashion_Pack/]Future Fashion Pack[/url] holds three fierce costumes to get you stumble-strutting on fashion’s slimiest catwalk.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1570380/Fall_Guys__Future_Fashion_Pack/

Before we go, a huge thank you to the Fall Guys community for your feedback, enthusiasm and inspiration. We hope you love Season 4 as much as we do (like, a lot) and we absolutely cannot wait to hear what you think!

Fall Guys Season 4 is playable NOW on PlayStation and Steam! You can also grab your Fall Guys fix on [url=https://twitter.com/FallGuysGame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/fallguysgame/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@fallguysgame]TikTok[/url], as well as joining your fellow beans on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/fallguys]official Discord server[/url]. Plus, sign up to our Mediatonic X Fall Guys [url=http://eepurl.com/hlEy8T]newsletter[/url]! Welcome to 4041 and see you in the Blunderdome...

notes.title: SEASON 2.5 UPDATE IS LIVE!
notes.content:
After transporting players into the domain of medieval mayhem for Season 2, we’ve dived back in with a hefty order of round remixes, oodles of community-inspired improvements and the addition of all-new Round, ‘Big Fans’. Come meet the content that’ll keep things fresh and fun in the lead up to Season 3…

[previewyoutube=v2GCnkNM5Nw;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]New Round Klaxon—Meet Big Fans![/h2]

Take the teetering tension of See Saw, but fill it with rapidly rotating blades and an unhealthy amount of opportunities for dive jumps. This sky-high race leaves little room for manoeuvre, with our scientists declaring an officially unsafe bean per blade ratio, meaning careful jostling is strongly advised.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/c93ac2e403bf482eeeaa3611cbfb6f84e6055f01.png[/img]

You’ll find checkpoints to temporarily save you from slimy humiliation, but taking risks could mean huge reward (and the honour of an EZ qual…). Slimline platforms link the zooming blades, meaning speedrun opportunities for particularly intrepid players, but with grabs at the opposition’s disposal, it’s going to be a bumpy ride.

We can’t wait to see how you take on Big Fans. It’s huge, new and very, very silly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211414/5a5d240cbf6cf29567c66f58528ea6d0252a4601.png[/img]


[h2]Here Comes the Remix—Our Rowdiest Round Variations Yet![/h2]

Equipped with possibly the most absurd arsenal in the history of soft play, our team has decided to lovingly sprinkle obstacles across our Season 2 and classic Rounds alike. Levels will now come in a variety of devious flavours with new obstacles popping up by chance to disrupt everything you thought you knew about your favourite Rounds!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1343612/extras/MatchFallSpinner.gif[/img]

notes.title: Next Fall Guys patch will address the top five most frequent crashes
notes.content:
After a busy launch month, Fall Guys is getting a major patch next week that will bring a selection of tweaks to the battle royale game, as well as remedy some of the more common glitches and bugs.

Developer Mediatonic preemptively released the patch notes on Twitter, listing all the changes coming to the multiplayer game. To start, the algorithm will now only select team games if there's an even number of players. A gameplay exploit in Jump Showdown will be stopped, and some of the surfaces in Slime Climb altered so players can't grab them. Text is being changed in the in-game store to prevent accidental purchases, and some outfits are getting visual fixes.

Depending on your experience, the most exciting entry is likely that the top five most frequent crashes are being addressed. Being an online game that's only been available to the public a few weeks, it's an unfortunate reality that some unforeseen, major bugs can emerge, crashing the game for some players. From next week, there'll be significantly less of the more common ones to worry about.

notes.title: Fall Guys' Big Yeetus and the Anti-Cheatus update is here
notes.content:
September 15, 2020 Oh, lord. Mediatonic says its latest attempt to battle hackers is comin'.

Not even Fall Guys is safe from hackers. Since the cute bumble royale stumbled onto the scene, players have taken to using cheats and exploits to snag victories. Mediatonic initially swapped up how its detection system works to boot them in the middle of a game, and stop them from using an exploit that came from creating new family-sharing accounts on Steam. The developer's latest attempt to kick cheating to the curb is now here.

The multiplayer game's social media manager reveals on Discord that the new update introduces the same anti-cheat system that Fortnite uses. We had an idea this was coming, but didn't have an exact date. If you're unaware, Fornite uses the Easy Anti-Cheat, which is developed by a company called Kamu that Epic Games bought back in 2018. The same anti-cheat is also used in Apex Legends, The Division 2, Gears 5, and many more.

We also got a story recently about the rise and fall of Cheater Island. Basically, Mediatonic used to banish cheaters to a game lobby where they'd all play against each other. The results are as amazing as you'd think, but Cheater Island swiftly ran into population issues.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: The Starting Lineup
notes.content:
We wanted to give an update on what that start line will look like when you finally get a chance to play! As of today we’re targeting a 60 person player count for closed beta and beyond into launch- here’s why:

1. 60 players creates the perfect amount of chaos. 
When we first started working on Fall Guys we had to ballpark our player count based purely on what felt right to us, and 100 players became this talismanic number we decided to aim for. “100 players, 1 winner“ instantly gives players a sense of the mayhem they’re going to deal with, and two years ago was the standard for all Battle Royale titles (Fall Guys isn’t a battle royale per sé, but when explaining the game for the first time it helps to draw those parallels).

Once we started prototyping gameplay we quickly we found that players couldn’t really tell the difference between 50 and 100 contestants. Regularly we’d ask players “how many Fall Guys did that feel like you were playing with?” and their response was often twice as high as the actual number that were in-game with them. It turned out that we didn’t need as many players as we thought to create the crowds we wanted the gameplay to include.

We also began to find that 100 players made even our simplest levels too crowded and ultimately less fun. Players would lose their Fall Guy in giant bundles trying to fit through small gaps, and if we made our levels bigger they were too large and cavernous to feel cohesive. Once we reduced player counts to 60 we found the horde of Fall Guys still invoked all the craziness we wanted, but without any of the frustration and confusion that the extra 40 Fall Guys brought with them.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/vsmfukibxsuz/5Ab6tjoW8WUYiZmrNNUAZU/1b6cbd0ac5e3b2a6a5a2d68213947d46/ezgif-5-aac466e928c3.gif[/img]
This is how crazy things can get on a 40 player Round!

2. Better performance across the board. 
It also makes sense for us to aim to keep our player count as low as possible because a higher player count means more time spent matchmaking. We want players to have minimal downtime between Shows, and finding 60 players to play together have proved to be exponentially faster than finding 100.

On top of this we’re able to push both our networking and rendering budgets further with less objects on screen. At launch, players will be able to experience more accurate networking and more detailed visuals- 40% more in fact! (note, this number is made up by me and is in no way backed up by engineering or art teams).

3. More wins for everyone! 
Your chance of winning just jumped from 1/100 to 1/60! We want Fall Guys to be a game anybody can pick up and enjoy, and by reducing our player count slightly we’re able to get more players through those early rounds and ultimately give everyone a better chance of leaving with the crown in their hands. We want everyone to feel like they’ve got a fair shot at victory (yes, even you).

Ultimately we’re still in development and things could change between now and launch, but through extensive playtesting we’re finding that 60 Fall Guys strikes the perfect balance of chaos and fun. We believe it’s going to create the best experience for players when they get their hands on the game during closed beta, and ultimately when the game goes live this summer. 

We can’t wait to see you on the startline!
